arStrings.szText: Folly of the Flock
A coward's cage is built by their own hands.

The "Zelos" are behind the children's disappearances. They offer children to the sea for luck and riches. But they seem to have a new benefactor. 

Their next target is vagrant children in the southern ruins. I must stop these sacrifices and find the root of this madness.
Speak with Dolos and Tymon
